provider: uploader.jp / getuploader.com (アップローダーレンタル)

free_tier.stated: 10 GB total per account: 100 MB per file, 1,000 MB per uploader, 10 uploaders per account = 10 GB. Free, and the terms state '当サイトが金銭を要求することは一切ありません'.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: 1 GB per uploader, 10 GB per account. No retention limit (persistent hosting, unlike the transfer services), which is the one thing it does better than Gigafile.

egress.terms: No meter; ad-supported on download pages.

tooling: Per-uploader web forms with no API. Community-maintained link lists exist (w.atwiki.jp/vbmaker, uploaders.jp).
chaining: 10 uploaders x 1 GB inside one account; multiple accounts would be needed to pass 500 GB, and 100 MB per file is the hard wall — this cannot hold bulk data of any kind.
